negative_results: A schedule read before the manifest is sealed is refused (refuse_read_before_seal): premature access to the assignment is detected and blocked.
A reorder of the schedule after the commit is refused (refuse_post_commit_reorder): post-hoc cherry-picking of run order is blocked.
A swapped or altered schedule fails its commitment (verify returns False), while the true schedule reproduces it.
Re-sealing an already-sealed manifest is refused, so a schedule cannot be swapped and re-committed.
A confirmatory claim after unblinding is refused (refuse_confirmatory_after_unblind); analysis_status collapses to EXPLORATORY_ONLY once the assignment is seen.
Empty condition sets and duplicate Latin-square symbols are refused; a non-Latin grid fails is_latin_square.
No physical measurement, acquisition, or run is performed or claimed; the module tops out at SOFTWARE_IMPLEMENTED, a non-measurement class.
reopening_test: Regenerate any sealed schedule from its committed seed and design hash and confirm commit_schedule reproduces the stored commitment; then alter one element of the schedule and confirm RandomizationManifest.verify returns False. If a regenerated true schedule fails to match its commitment, or an altered schedule matches, or refuse_read_before_seal / refuse_post_commit_reorder stops raising, reopen the phase. Run: pytest tests/v8/test_randomization.py -q.
acceptance_checklist: Focused tests pass: 24 passed in tests/v8/test_randomization.py.
randomize(conditions, seed) is reproducible: same seed => identical order; different seed => different order.
Balanced designs verified: random_blocks balanced (each condition once per block); latin_square valid (each symbol once per row and column).
Schedule is pre-committed: RandomizationManifest.seal() takes a SHA-256 commitment over seed + design hash + schedule; the committed seed plus design hash makes the assignment tamper-evident.
Premature access detected: refuse_read_before_seal blocks reading the assignment before the seal.
Post-hoc reordering refused: refuse_post_commit_reorder blocks any reorder after commit.
Unblinding invalidates confirmatory status: refuse_confirmatory_after_unblind raises; analysis_status returns EXPLORATORY_ONLY.
Restart and deviation policy: restart derives a deterministic new seed and logs a Deviation; deviations are recorded and never dropped.
Deterministic and clock-free: numpy default_rng(seed) and derived sub-seeds only; no wall-clock reads.
Reuses r13.serialize (canonical hash) and r15.claims; no sibling r15 phase module hard-imported; no duplicate truth system.
randomization_report() carries claim_class, measured_here='nothing', physical_validation, and verdict.
Privacy scan clean: synthetic fixtures only; no private inputs read; the pack DO_NOT_COMMIT directory was not accessed.
Receipt validated against r15/schemas/phase_receipt.schema.json with jsonschema.
